fact: The 2024 Time Release Study states Nafeza has been enhanced to electronically receive cargo manifests, customs declarations and trade documents, and that declarations are lodged by brokers by direct input; average sea cargo release fell from 16 days in 2021 to 8 days in 2024 at Alexandria, El Dekhila and Damietta.
title: 2024 Time Release Study (TRS) Egypt Customs Authority
